Which statement best describes how parental care in crocodiles compared to turtles works?

questions.question: Crocodiles exhibit remarkable parental care behavior by taking hatchlings to water, while turtles typically lay their eggs in the sand without providing protection. This differing behavior is adapted to their respective habitats and reproductive strategies.
choices: B: Turtles actively guard their nests, while crocodiles lay their eggs in the mud without further protection.
C: Crocodiles dig their nests in the sand, while turtles lay their eggs in water and leave them to themselves.
D: Both crocodiles and turtles protect their nests until hatching, with turtles laying their eggs in water.

What is the main goal in the game of chess?

The main goal in chess is to threaten the opponent's king in a way that it cannot escape, known as checkmate. All other aspects of the game are strategically important, but checkmate is the decisive victory.

questions.question: A: Remove all own pieces from the board.
choices: C: Checkmate the opponent's king.
D: Have the most pawns on the board.

Which of the following hormones is mainly produced by the thyroid gland and influences the body's metabolism?

Thyroxine (T4) is produced by the thyroid gland and plays a central role in metabolism by regulating energy consumption and body temperature. Insulin is produced by the pancreas, while adrenaline and cortisol come from the adrenal glands and control various stress responses in the body.
A: Thyroxine (T4)

questions.question: B: Insulin
choices: D: Adrenaline
